notes: The New Duplicator's selection modes, plant mode, fill colour, fill wrench, supercut, fill bricks, force plant, mirroring, cutting, saving and loading as host rules on the native copy seams, with its preference defaults: anyone may use it, full trust to select (admins may select anything, public bricks too), 10,000 bricks a selection (its 1,000,000 for admins is cut to the 10,000 a copy holds here), a 64-unit box for players (its 1024 for admins is cut to 256), a 0.4 s select wait for non-admins, saving, fill wrench, FX paint, force plant and fill bricks for admins only. Stack mode selects up or down, limited or not, and Ctrl (shared with crouch, as the original bound it) adds to the selection; [Light] switches to box mode, turning a selection into a box round it, where a click boxes a brick (with Ctrl, grows the box to the plate clicked), the brick keys move a corner (with Ctrl, the whole box), [Rotate Brick] switches corner (with Ctrl, turns the box) and [Plant Brick] selects what lies in the box. A selection glows for a few seconds and stays a selection until a brick key takes it up as a ghost (plant mode); the brick keys move it, a click puts it against what was clicked, and [Plant Brick] plants what fits and says how much was blocked, floating or missing trust. With a selection, a paint or FX can is fill colour ([Plant Brick] paints it, one undo step); /FillWrench opens the wrench on every selected brick; /SuperCut deletes what reaches into the box and puts plain bricks back over what stuck out, and /FillBricks then fills the box in the player's colour, each asked first and each one undo step (the original's supercut had no undo); /ForcePlant and /ToggleForcePlant plant bricks that would float. /MirrorX, /MirrorY and /MirrorZ mirror the ghost, /Cut cuts the originals away, /SaveDup and /LoadDup keep and load it by name (and load v20 duplication files from the game's Duplications folder). Not ported: the pivot setting (the whole selection is always the pivot, the original's default), plant as, /AllDups, /DupVersion, /DupClients, /MirErrors, the overwrite warning on /SaveDup, the plant wait, the undo confirmation for big plants, and selections over 10,000 bricks.
